pretreatment: cleaned at 70°C for 10 min in RCA solution (1:1:5 NH4OH/H2O2/H2O) following dipping in buffered oxide etch solution for 30 s to remove native oxide, postdeposition annealing was carried out at 400°C for 10 min in an oxygen environment
evidence: the films were deposited on p-type (boron doped, 5×1014 cm−3) Si substrates, which were cleaned at 70°C for 10 min in RCA solution (1:1:5 NH4OH/H2O2/H2O) following dipping in buffered oxide etch solution for 30 s to remove native oxide. Next, to reduce the trap charges, postdeposition annealing was carried out at 400°C for 10 min in an oxygen environment
